name: Las Futas
source: The game takes place in Las Futas, the most popular city in futa, as well as one of the largest entertainment and gambling centers in the world. Where futas, femboys, and women live. The earth is dominated by futa who have more rights and opportunities compared to femboys and women The main characters are the son, who is a femboy and his mother, who is a female. They have different love lives and different stories that will overlap and influence each other.
